set.body:
Outcome
Make the theme reproducibly buildable and usable from Java or Scala.

Owned scope
build.sbt; project; tokens; theme module; notices

Prerequisites
A1, A2, A3

Acceptance criteria
- [x] A1–A3 pass with exact versions and source provenance.
- [x] A clean build launches the initial native themed scene and resolves a coherent JavaFX 27 runtime.
- [x] Generated resources and metrics are deterministic; palette relationships and the minimal control state set pass.

Required evidence
A1–A3 build, generation, parser, runtime and contrast receipts.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code E0. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.

Local acceptance
2026-10-14: docs/evidence/a3/README.md, verification.json and source-manifest.json. Source candidate b0fa075adaf1d3704de887df93345f3ce59d7e641be157275abd2a46d7a6da35 (123 hashes); packaged theme JAR 8975ca80efa03b2a3e7c70f5c76a6010dcb8e664e50ad4f9ae1235581d924f3d. Four compiled themes; final clean build/native and independent Java consumer exit0; 245 native assertions, 12 inspected captures, 28 Python checks, A2 contrast224+12 exemptions preserved. CI configured but unrun hosted. Scope remains initial macOS controls; dock/scientific/a11y/platform qualification and publication retain later gates.
